scenario_description: Old incident republished in recent article — 10-year retrospective

rationale: Recent publication date, but article is an anniversary retrospective of a historical 2011 event with zero current impact. Must be filtered as not relevant.

scenario_description: Ongoing incident that began 12 days ago with current follow-up coverage

input.snippet: Dockers continue blockade of container gates for the 12th consecutive day. Shippers warn critical import backlogs are now threatening assembly plants across Western Europe.

rationale: Event began >7 days ago, but the article is fresh and explicitly reports active, continuing paralyzed operations today.

scenario_description: Resolved incident with complete resumption and zero continuing impact

input.title: Operations fully resumed at Dresden microelectronics facility following power check
input.snippet: Semiconductor manufacturer announced all cleanroom tools have returned to normal 100% capacity after yesterday's brief utility inspection. All delivery schedules are fully on track.

rationale: Clean resolution with zero backlog or operational delay. Must be filtered out to prevent false alert.

scenario_description: Resolved incident with continuing operational backlogs and production delays

input.title: Port strike ended yesterday as workers ratify contract, but weeks of container backlog remain
input.snippet: Although dockers returned to terminals this morning after signing the labor pact, port authority warned a severe backlog of 150,000 delayed containers will disrupt supply chains through November.

rationale: Labor strike concluded, but significant operational delay and container backlog persist actively impacting supply chains. Must remain active.

scenario_description: Temporary reopening followed by another emergency shutdown

input.snippet: After briefly resuming operations following water main repairs, the facility suffered a major chemical line leak requiring a second immediate evacuation and complete shutdown.

rationale: Mentions both brief resumption and immediate renewed shutdown; net operational status is actively disrupted.

scenario_description: One article mentioning both a resolved incident and a new active incident

input.title: Labor dispute settled at rail yard, but flash floods now paralyze regional freight line
input.snippet: While unions ratified a new contract ending the week-long strike at the depot, sudden torrential rainfall has washed out main rail tracks, halting all freight traffic.

rationale: Dual-incident reporting: labor resolved, but new environmental disruption is actively shutting down the corridor.
